architecture_outline: Use Vue 3 Single-File Components with clear boundaries.
Separate UI, reusable reactive logic, API requests, and shared state when warranted.
Keep authoritative validation, prices, inventory, authentication, and payment verification on a backend.
reference_approach: For Real-Time Collaboration Interface, implement Real-time event updates and connection status, User presence and message history, Shared state and stale-event handling, Automated tests for connection lifecycle. Follow milestone order, keep state in one source of truth, and use the official documentation linked in the course.
review_checklist: Real-time event updates and connection status
A normal and a failure/boundary case have repeatable evidence.
The build, runtime assumptions, and any untested paths are documented.
